issue.title: test_monitor_result persist_monitor_result bounded-wait tests fail under the full parallel lane, pass on rerun
issue.description: Found by the sase-17x.13.10 land agent. In the escalated full lane of sase tool run check on master 7cb835953 plus a Command Line-only diff (47647 passed, 5 failed, host load 15-22), both tests/continuation/test_monitor_result.py::test_persist_monitor_result_waits_for_a_starter_still_finalizing and ::test_persist_monitor_result_stamps_needs_recovery_after_bounded_wait failed; an immediate rerun of both on a clean tree (changes stashed) passed. Both exercise the bounded wait for a still-finalizing starter, so a fixed wall-clock bound under host load is the likely cause (unconfirmed). Root cause not investigated.

task_type_fields.evidence: 1 fail / 1 pass on an unchanged tree for each of the two bounded-wait nodes; failed in the full parallel lane, passed serially. Sibling node: tests/continuation/test_monitor_result.py::test_persist_monitor_result_stamps_needs_recovery_after_bounded_wait.
